item.title: SC Collegium recommends Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari as Chief Justice of Madras High Court
item.description: The recommendation has been forwarded to the Union Government for further action in accordance with the constitutional procedure governing judicial appointments. The post SC Collegium recommends Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari as Chief Justice of Madras High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Supreme Court Collegium adopts policy of advance transfer for Chief Justice-designates
item.description: To improve administrative continuity and judicial efficiency, the Supreme Court Collegium has decided that Chief Justice-designates should be transferred to their new High Courts in advance of vacancies arising. The post Supreme Court Collegium adopts policy of advance transfer for Chief Justice-designates appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: The Digital Afterlife: Post-Mortem Privacy and Proprietary Rights in the Information Age
item.description: by Shweta Chaturvedi* The post The Digital Afterlife: Post-Mortem Privacy and Proprietary Rights in the Information Age appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Intention at time of entry determinative factor under S. 441 IPC; Mere entry into property not sufficient to establish criminal trespass: Orissa HC
item.description: “The entry must be accompanied by the requisite criminal intent as defined under Section 441 IPC and, in the case of Section 450 IPC, such intent must be to commit an offence punishable with imprisonment for life”. The post Intention at time of entry determinative factor under S. 441 IPC; Mere entry into property not sufficient to establish criminal trespass: Orissa HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Married man engaging in sexual relations with promise of marriage is deceit from very beginning: Allahabad High Court
item.description: “The accused while entering into sexual intercourse with the victim knew that he is a married man and his false promise of marriage to the victim will be broken.” The post Married man engaging in sexual relations with promise of marriage is deceit from very beginning: Allahabad High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court protects Swami Ramdev’s Personality Rights; directs take down of AI-generated deepfakes
item.description: “The plaintiff, Swami Ramdev is a known and renowned personality in the fields of yoga and ayurvedic medicine, in India and abroad. Through several institutes, he is advancing yoga education, healthcare and Ayurvedic treatment and is also engaged in various philanthropic endeavours. item.title: DGCA notifies new airline ticket refund rules; faster refunds and 48-hour cancellation window introduced
item.description: To address growing passenger grievances over delayed refunds and opaque cancellation policies, the DGCA has issued new Civil Aviation Requirements prescribing mandatory refund timelines, a 48-hour “look-in” cancellation option, and full refund of statutory taxes across all fare categories. The post DGCA notifies new airline ticket refund rules; faster refunds and 48-hour cancellation window introduced appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Punjab Government (Pakistan) Issues Stamp Duty Exemption Notification on Corporate Mergers in Pakistan
item.description: Government of Punjab, Pakistan, grants stamp duty exemption for mergers to support corporate restructuring and eliminate provincial barriers to compliance. The post Punjab Government (Pakistan) Issues Stamp Duty Exemption Notification on Corporate Mergers in Pakistan appeared first on SCC Times.

item.description: Moot Court Committee, School of Law, NMIMS Navi Mumbai announces the Fifth Annual Moot Court Competition 2026 on Securities Law. item.title: Pre-existing dispute irrelevant once debt and default proved: Supreme Court restores Section 7 IBC proceedings
item.description: Unapproved restructuring of loan facility not in compliance with the Debenture Trust Deed cannot defeat the admission of Section 7 IBC application once financial debt and default are established. The post Pre-existing dispute irrelevant once debt and default proved: Supreme Court restores Section 7 IBC proceedings appeared first on SCC Times.
